annotations.title: Skills ads ask for in a role

description: The skills job ads in Finland ask for in one role, most common first, each with the share of ads naming it and, where at least 10 ads on each side state pay, the median monthly pay difference between ads that name the skill and ads that do not. Fits "what skills do I need to become a data analyst". The role can be given in any language. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.
